name: Tamed Incantations increases Echo Fragment's own duration-modifier effect by 500ms (#565)
contract: Tamed Incantations 706077 carries a vestigial zero-value SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT (290) effect plus a real SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) effect with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 (12) and EffectSpellClassMask word0 bit 0x10, matching Echo Fragment 804455's own SpellFamilyFlags word0 (16). Echo Fragment's own effect index 1 is itself SPELLMOD_DURATION (op 1) scoped to Continuum spells (5000ms per stack); Tamed Incantations raises that per-stack value by 500 (EffectBasePoints 499 resolves to 500 with DieSides 1), which is how 'increases Continuum spell duration per Echo Fragment' is implemented, since AuraEffect::CalculateAmount multiplies every effect's amount by the aura's current stack count (SpellAuraEffects.cpp).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Echo Fragment's duration effect unmodified without the talent
Echo Fragment's duration effect gains 500 with the talent
